posts.title: Core training speeds sprints and lifts jumps, 49 studies show
posts.excerpt: A Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis of 49 studies found core training raised sprint speed and jump height across sports. The verdict: treat core work as the complement to sport-specific sprint,…
posts.body: A [Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2026.1946447/full) of 49 studies found core training raised sprint speed and jump height across sports. The verdict: treat core work as the complement to sport-specific sprint, strength, and plyometric blocks, not the program itself.

posts.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for IceCube neutrino work
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 6, 2026, 11:00 AM. The 82-year-old Belgian astrophysicist proposed the IceCube Neutrino Observatory back in 1988, betting a cubic kilometer of Antarctic ice threaded with light sensors…
posts.body: Published Oct 6, 2026, 11:00 AM. The 82-year-old Belgian astrophysicist proposed the IceCube Neutrino Observatory back in 1988, betting a cubic kilometer of Antarctic ice threaded with light sensors could trap particles that pass through planets untouched. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences [awarded him the 2026 physics prize Tuesday](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/06/science/nobel-prize-physics-francis-halzen-winner-intl?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta) for the discovery of high-energy cosmic neutrinos.

A second blood profile from the maintenance garage sat unmatched for 14 years until a November 2024 firearms conviction forced Colon's DNA into CODIS.

posts.title: Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel win 2026 Nobel medicine prize
posts.excerpt: Karl Deisseroth of Stanford, Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University and Georg Nagel of the University of Würzburg won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their discoveries on…
posts.body: Karl Deisseroth of Stanford, Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University and Georg Nagel of the University of Würzburg won the [2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine](https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/deisseroth-hegemann-nagelwin-2026-nobel-medicine-prize-2026-10-05/) for their discoveries on light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. The technique turns light into a precision switch for individual nerve cells in a living brain, and it is now standard equipment in neuroscience labs worldwide.

posts.body: Erin Barbato, director of the University of Wisconsin Law School's Immigrant Justice Clinic, told Wisconsin Public Radio the clinic will not receive the federal funding it expected, after two years of work toward hiring a staff attorney and a paralegal for detained children under 12 in removal proceedings. [WPR, via MigraPrep](https://migraprep.com/en/news/wisconsin-detained-children-legal-funding-cut-2026-10-02/), tied the expected money to the $810 million in congressionally approved spending the White House moved to withhold on September 25, a "pocket rescission" that GAO's standing position says can violate federal law without Congress's approval, with MigraPrep stressing the loss is potential and no case yet shown decided.

posts.body: A Russian drone [struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge on Sunday morning](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/04/europe/russian-drone-kyiv-merz-ukraine?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta) as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the city, injuring two people. Berlin is expected to release €1 billion in military aid.

posts.title: Dallas police arrest suspect in 30-year-old cold case
posts.excerpt: Dallas police arrested Gary Len Ross, 56, on Friday and charged him with capital murder in the 1993 killing of Tommie Davis, who was found beaten and slashed inside her Haskell Avenue home on May 18,…
posts.body: Dallas police arrested Gary Len Ross, 56, on Friday and charged him with capital murder in the 1993 killing of Tommie Davis, who was found beaten and slashed inside her Haskell Avenue home on May 18, 1993, [per FOX 4's reporting](https://fox4news.com/news/dallas-police-make-arrest-30-year-old-cold-case). The break came from blood on a wall of Davis's home that was not hers: a CODIS match returned the name Tommy Lynn Jones, which investigators determined was Ross's alias.

posts.title: Heat hits fast marathoners hardest
posts.excerpt: Researchers tracked 1,938 male runners across three Japanese marathons at 6.5°C, 20.6°C, and 28.2°C, and average finish times rose from 223 minutes in the cool race to 281 in the extreme heat. In the…
posts.body: Researchers tracked 1,938 male runners across three Japanese marathons at 6.5°C, 20.6°C, and 28.2°C, and average [finish times rose from 223 minutes in the cool race to 281 in the extreme heat](https://scienmag.com/heat-rewrites-the-rules-of-marathon-performance-study-of-nearly-2000-runners-finds/). In the hottest race the link between personal best and finish time flattened, with faster runners losing proportionally more, while weekly distance and training frequency kept predicting faster finishes at every temperature.

posts.body: OpenAI's GPT-6 pricing docs carry a surcharge the headline rate never mentions: [past 272K input tokens, input and cached reads bill at 2x and output at 1.5x across the entire request](https://www.swfte.com/blog/gpt-6-sol-pricing-gpt-6-luna-gpt-6-1-sol-price-cut-2026). Past that line, Claude Sonnet 5.5 costs half what GPT-6.1 Sol does for the same size request.

posts.title: Russia strikes another Kyiv bridge as attacks escalate
posts.excerpt: A Russian strike hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on Saturday, injuring two people and knocking out its road surface and the trolleybus power lines, per CNN's reporting. Ukrainian officials say the bridge…
posts.body: A Russian strike hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on Saturday, injuring two people and knocking out its road surface and the trolleybus power lines, [per CNN's reporting](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/03/europe/russia-strikes-northern-southern-bridges-kyiv-attacks-intl?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta). Ukrainian officials say the bridge campaign is effectively cutting the capital in two, a day after the Southern Bridge was struck five times in under 24 hours and shut down, [per the same report](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/03/europe/russia-strikes-northern-southern-bridges-kyiv-attacks-intl?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta).

posts.title: Ling 3.1 Flash free in Cline through Oct 13
posts.excerpt: Ling 3.1 Flash is a 560-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model aimed at coding, multi-step analysis, and tool-using agents. Cline is offering it free inside its open-source agent runtime, where…
posts.body: Ling 3.1 Flash is a 560-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model aimed at coding, multi-step analysis, and tool-using agents. Cline is offering it free inside its open-source agent runtime, where developers can swap models in and out, betting the harness outlasts any single model, [per the write-up](https://runtimewire.com/article/cline-ling-3-1-flash-free-desktop).

posts.title: Long runs take 90g of carbs per hour
posts.excerpt: Eight elite runners taking 120g of carbohydrate per hour used 8% less oxygen at the same pace than those taking 60g in a Journal of Applied Physiology trial, per a roundup that states no publication…
posts.body: Eight elite runners taking 120g of carbohydrate per hour used 8% less oxygen at the same pace than those taking 60g in a Journal of Applied Physiology trial, [per a roundup that states no publication date](https://www.newsbeep.com/ie/643392/). The tradeoff was more nausea, fullness, and cramps at the high dose, which is why the advice is to train the gut upward gradually.

posts.title: Navy taps Saronic among three yards for $280M LCU 1700 push
posts.excerpt: Baird Maritime reported Sept 16 that the Navy had handed Saronic Technologies of Brownsville one of three competitive prototype agreements for its next-generation LCU 1700 landing craft, under a…
posts.body: [Baird Maritime](https://www.bairdmaritime.com/security/naval/naval-auxiliary-support/us-navy-awards-three-prototype-agreements-to-accelerate-landing-craft-production) reported Sept 16 that the Navy had handed Saronic Technologies of Brownsville one of three competitive prototype agreements for its next-generation LCU 1700 landing craft, under a $280,521,389 initial construction obligation. Each yard will build two or three prototypes and refine its manufacturing plans for high-rate production.

posts.title: Strength training may cut visceral fat in seven days in mice
posts.excerpt: Researchers found seven days of resistance exercise reduced visceral fat around the organs and shrank inflamed fat cells in mice, per Mid-Day. The change traced to reactivated fat-clearing proteins…
posts.body: Researchers found seven days of resistance exercise reduced visceral fat around the organs and shrank inflamed fat cells in mice, [per Mid-Day](https://www.mid-day.com/news/world-news/article/strength-training-may-reduce-visceral-fat-in-just-seven-days-study-finds-in-mice-23653084). The change traced to reactivated fat-clearing proteins and lower fat-producing gene activity, improving metabolic health at the cellular level, [per the same report](https://www.mid-day.com/news/world-news/article/strength-training-may-reduce-visceral-fat-in-just-seven-days-study-finds-in-mice-23653084).

posts.title: Newer Claude models emit ~30% more tokens, so re-measure your budgets
posts.excerpt: Claude 4.7 and later models use a newer tokenizer that produces about 30 percent more tokens for the same text, so upgrading from Sonnet 4.6 to a 5.x model can raise your bill even though the…
posts.body: Claude 4.7 and later models use a newer tokenizer that produces about 30 percent more tokens for the same text, so upgrading from Sonnet 4.6 to a 5.x model can raise your bill even though the per-token price went down, [per the breakdown](https://dev.to/mehdimohseni82/your-ai-cost-model-is-already-wrong-tokenizers-context-cliffs-and-session-hours-1aj2). That silently breaks any cost projection or local token-budget logic you built on the old tokenizer, so re-measure on the new one rather than assuming your numbers still hold, [per the same analysis](https://dev.to/mehdimohseni82/your-ai-cost-model-is-already-wrong-tokenizers-context-cliffs-and-session-hours-1aj2).
